title: Koala wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,35 62,35' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,22 56,22' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='35' x2='62' y2='35' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- Hat pom-pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='44,22 42,29 58,29 56,22' fill='#6EE7F9'/>
  <polygon points='43,29 41,35 59,35 58,29' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='38' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#C0A98E'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='38' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#E8D5BC'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='38' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#C0A98E'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='38' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#E8D5BC'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#A8A29E'/>
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#E8D5BC'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='54' r='6' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='54' r='6' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='5' ry='2.5' fill='#6B6B8A'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M44 72 Q50 77 56 72' fill='none' stroke='#7A6A55' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='5' fill='#F4A6B8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='66' r='5' fill='#F4A6B8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Body / shoulders hint -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='94' rx='26' ry='14' fill='#A8A29E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='94' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#C0A98E'/>
</svg>
